title: ipomoea corneri
intro: Ipomoea corneri, commonly known as the Himalayan Ipomoea or Himalayan Moonseed, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Ipomoea corneri include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
